question: Which feature of the Right to Information framework most strengthens citizen oversight of public authorities?
options: Mandatory proactive disclosure of key information
Exclusive judicial handling of information requests
Prior government approval before filing applications
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 48/2026 (Special Branch Asst, 16 May 2026). The correct answer is Mandatory proactive disclosure of key information.

question: Which among the following political party used oil lamp as an election symbol in its elections upto 1977?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 141/2025 (HST Social Science, 4 Nov 2025). The correct answer is Jan Sangh.

question: Which of the following statement(s) is /are true with reference to the Joint sitting of the Parliament? (i) According to Article 108, the President can make rules for the procedure of the joint sitting after due consultation with the Chairman of the Council of States and the Speaker of the House of the People. (ii) The President of India has the power to call a joint sitting (iii) In the absence of the Speaker and the Deputy speaker of the Lok Sabha, the joint sitting of the Parliament is presided by the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 76/2025 (Higher Secondary School Teacher, 30 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Only (ii).

question: Which statement(s) regarding the Estimates Committee is/ are True? (i) The Estimates Committee is the Largest Committee of the Parliament (ii) The term of the committee is Two years (iii) Estimates committee consisting of members from both Houses of Parliament
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 76/2025 (Higher Secondary School Teacher, 30 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Only (i).

question: Consider the statements given below : (i) 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 moved Four subjects from the State List to the Concurrent List. (ii) Article 248 empowers the Parliament to legislate with respect to a matter in the State List in the national interest. (iii) Establishment of standards of weight and measure is included in the Union List. Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct regarding the 7th Schedule of the Constitution of India?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 76/2025 (Higher Secondary School Teacher, 30 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Only (iii).

question: Consider the following statements regarding 8th Schedule of the Constitution of India : (i) The 71st Amendment to the Indian Constitution included Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali languages in the 8th Schedule. (ii) The Sindhi language was added in the 8th Schedule by the 31st Amendment Act. (iii) Bodo, Dongri, Maithili and Santhali were added by the 92nd Amendment Act. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 76/2025 (Higher Secondary School Teacher, 30 Jun 2025). The correct answer is Only (i) and (iii) A 17.

explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 044/2024 (Assistant, 23 Apr 2024). The correct answer is K.R. Narayanan.

question: Which one is not a responsibility of the Public Information Officer as per the Right to Information Act of 2005?

To forward the information to the judiciary for approval
To ensure disposal of the requests within a prescribed time period
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 193/2023 (Non Vocational Teacher in General Foundation Course, 4 Oct 2023). The correct answer is To forward the information to the judiciary for approval.

explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 078/2022 (HSST English, 23 Jul 2022). The correct answer is The Parliament of India.

explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 097/2021 (HSST Journalism, 29 Sep 2021). The correct answer is Justice J.S. Khehar.

question: Which of the following statement is/are correct explanation(s) of Panchayati Raj System in India ? i. Article 40 of the Constitution which enshrines one of the directive Principles of State Policy lays down that the State shall take steps to organise village Panchayats. ii. 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act inserted Part IX to the Constitution of India. iii. question: Which of the following statements correctly represents the judicial stance on Fundamental Duties (Article 51A)?
options: Fundamental Duties are legally enforceable under Article 32
Duties are irrelevant to interpreting Fundamental Rights.
Duties serve as interpretative aids to define the scope of Fundamental Rights and public interest.
Duties have replaced the Directive Principles in constitutional jurisprudence.
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 163/2025 (Welfare Officer Gr II, 2 Dec 2025). The correct answer is Duties serve as interpretative aids to define the scope of Fundamental Rights and public interest..

question: Under the RTE Act, 2009, private schools are mandated to reserve what percentage of seats for children from disadvantaged sections?
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 163/2025 (Welfare Officer Gr II, 2 Dec 2025). The correct answer is 25%.

question: Match the constitutional provisions with their purposes : Column A Column B a. Article 14 1. Protection of life and personal liberty b. Article 15 2. Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, sex, caste, etc. c. Article 21 3. Equality before law d. Article 39A 4. Equal justice and free legal aid Options :
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 163/2025 (Welfare Officer Gr II, 2 Dec 2025). The correct answer is a-3, b-2, c-1, d-4.

question: Under the Protection of Human Rights Act (PHRA), 1993 (as amended in 2019), which of the following statements best reflects the quasi-judicial nature of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)?
options: NHRC can enforce its recommendations through contempt powers
NHRC can summon witnesses, examine evidence and recommend actions to the government but cannot enforce its decisions
NHRC acts only as an advisory body with no investigative powers
NHRC can directly prosecute violators before human rights courts
explanation: This question was asked in Kerala PSC exam 163/2025 (Welfare Officer Gr II, 2 Dec 2025). The correct answer is NHRC can summon witnesses, examine evidence and recommend actions to the government but cannot enforce its decisions.

question: Which one of the following is not included in the institutions of the self-government in the urban area as per Article 243 Q, Constitution of India?

A Zila Panchayat for district level transitional area

A Municipal Corporation for a larger urban area

Any procedural irregularity automatically invalidates Council’s proceedings
